issues.where: encoded column, rows 2 and 3, especially the field behind the central sunflower
issues.what: Fine stems and petal edges merge into patchy clumps. The foreground flower still reads, but the field loses distinct texture at native size.
issues.fix: Shift the 5 Mbit/s bit budget toward the field reveal using scene-aware two-pass allocation and a slower encoding preset.

issues.where: encoded column, rain against the clouds and over the far ground
issues.what: Thin, continuous rain streaks become uneven, broken dashes, and the cloud and horizon haze develops coarse patches.
issues.fix: Give the storm shot more bits within the average budget and use a slower preset to preserve the rain streaks.

issues.where: encoded column, golden haze below the sun in row 1 and blue sky above the horizon in row 3
issues.what: Smooth tonal transitions break into faint bands and flat patches at native size, beyond the expected loss of fine grain.
issues.fix: Keep the sky and glow at higher precision through grading, then test subtle dithering and stronger gradient protection in the delivery encode.

issues.where: encoded column, dark blue sky above the growing tip in rows 1 and 2
issues.what: A number of discrete faint stars disappear or merge into diffuse mottling while the brightest stars remain.
issues.fix: Allocate more bits to the night shot and test a detail-preserving encoder tune against the native-size star field.
